From src/MOLECULE/bond_table.cpp compute_table (414-445): tlm1 = tablength-1, `tb->delta = (tb->hi - tb->lo)/tlm1`, `tb->r[i] = tb->lo + i*tb->delta`, so r[tablength-1] == hi. FixWallLJ93Kokkos::wall_particle (144-178) does `atomKK->sync(execution_space,datamask_read);` and then binds only d_x (k_x), d_f (k_f) and d_mask (k_mask); the only other velocity-looking symbols in the file are k_vatom/d_vatom, the per-atom VIRIAL array, which is unrelated to V_MASK. Adjusted on impact: the claim that this 'copies the whole velocity array to the execution space before every post_force' overstates it. atomKK->sync(space,V_MASK) is a no-op unless v is currently claimed as modified in the other space, and in an all-/kk run the integrator updates v on the device, so the sync does nothing. The real cost only appears when a non-KOKKOS fix has touched v on the host, and even then the copy would usually happen anyway. So this is a correctness-of-declaration/hygiene item, not a measurable performance bug.
fix: Drop V_MASK from datamask_read in all seven files: fix_wall_lj93_kokkos.cpp:40, fix_wall_lj126_kokkos.cpp:33, fix_wall_lj1043_kokkos.cpp:37, fix_wall_morse_kokkos.cpp:35, fix_wall_harmonic_kokkos.cpp:33, fix_wall_harmonic_outside_kokkos.cpp:32, fix_wall_region_kokkos.cpp:47, leaving `X_MASK | F_MASK | MASK_MASK` (plus whatever fix_wall_region genuinely needs, e.g. RADIUS_MASK, tracked separately).
